seo.title: Hotel Zagi Oroslavje | Hotel near Zagreb on the A2
seo.description: Family-run 3-star hotel in Oroslavje, 30 min from Zagreb: comfortable rooms, a sauna wellness centre, Zagorje cuisine and a conference hall.

featureCardsIntro.heading: Everything for your stay in one place
featureCardsIntro.lead: Rooms, wellness, dining and a conference hall – under one roof, around thirty minutes from Zagreb.

featureCards.title: Accommodation
featureCards.text: Double, triple and family rooms with air conditioning, Wi-Fi and a private bathroom.

featureCards.title: Wellness
featureCards.text: Three saunas, a whirlpool, an ice fountain and a relaxation area. Packages with or without an overnight stay.

image.alt: Illuminated whirlpool with wooden steps and candles in the wellness centre

featureCards.title: Restaurant
featureCards.text: Home-style Zagorje cooking, a Sunday buffet, celebrations and catering.

intro.heading: A place people come back to
paragraphs: From chance visitors to travellers passing through, from family outings to important business meetings – Zagi is a place where people often stop by chance, and even more often return on purpose.
Among the gentle hills of Zagorje, in Oroslavje, just some thirty kilometres from Zagreb, we have been welcoming families, travellers and business guests since 1986.

image.alt: Entrance to the Zagi restaurant with a covered terrace and parked bicycles

cta.heading: Book directly with us
cta.text: Book directly with us, with no middleman. For groups, celebrations and business events, send us an enquiry – we reply quickly.
